description: Automatic view persistence for a CRM contacts grid in Svelte 5. attachAutoSavedView reserves one slot inside createNamedViews with localStorageViews and mirrors the grid view to it: sort, filter, hide, reorder or resize a column, reload the tab, and the layout is exactly where you left it. The grid has twelve editable columns with pipeline stages, deal values, owners and last-contact dates so the persistence has something worth keeping, and the same store can hold extra named layouts.

faq.question: How do I make the grid remember its layout across reloads?
faq.answer: In onApiReady create a named-views manager with localStorageViews and call attachAutoSavedView on it. From then on every change to the view is written to the reserved slot and restored on the next load.

faq.question: What is included in the saved view?
faq.answer: Sorting, column filters, column visibility, order and widths, everything api.getState() reports. Row data is not stored; it comes from your source as usual.

faq.question: Can users still save additional named views?
faq.answer: Yes. The auto-saved slot is reserved, and the same manager keeps saving, loading and deleting named views next to it.
